name: org-comm
description: Monorepo for the org communication platform (backend + frontend).

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm start --prefix backend" "npm start --prefix frontend"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run typecheck
